# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1990

**Position Allocation List for Salary Standardization**

## Summary

This ordinance formally adopts the Position Allocation List issued by the Joint Commission on Local Government Personnel Administration. This list serves as the basis for salary standardization for all municipal officials and rank-and-file employees of Pitogo, Quezon. The ordinance specifies that the Position Allocation List issued by the Joint Commission on Local Government Personnel Administration dated February 22, 1990, is adopted. The effectivity of the Position Allocation List is retroactive to January 1, 1990, and the ordinance takes effect immediately.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** The Position Allocation List issued by the Joint Commission on Local Government Personnel Administration dated February 22, 1990, is hereby adopted.
2.  **Section 2.** Effectivity of the Position Allocation List herein adopted shall be retroactive to January 1, 1990.
3.  **Section 3.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately.
